title: platanus orientalis var. nepalensis
intro: Platanus orientalis var. nepalensis, commonly known as the Himalayan or Nepal plane tree, is a deciduous tree species native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and treating gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Platanus orientalis var. nepalensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
